name: ESA WorldCover
description: Sentinel-derived land-cover classification used for developed-land fraction, natural habitat fraction and water/wetland exclusions.
limitations: Static 2021 land cover is not current construction status. A built-up pixel is not a verified available rooftop.

name: NASA SRTM
description: Radar elevation model. Terrain slope is computed deterministically in degrees for infrastructure screening.
limitations: Terrain dates to 2000. Cell mean slope can hide small steep areas; not a geotechnical assessment.

name: VIIRS Nighttime Lights
description: Cloud-coverage-masked monthly nighttime radiance provides activity context alongside candidate screening.
limitations: Radiance is not electricity demand. Transient lighting and artifacts remain possible.

name: NASA POWER Solar
vintage: API climatology period returned per request
description: All-sky surface shortwave downward irradiance climatology, used as a coarse screening proxy for solar generation.
limitations: Coarse satellite/model product. Not parcel-scale irradiance or a bankable yield study. Resolution varies by parameter.

name: ERA5 Wind Reanalysis
description: Compute sqrt(u100² + v100²) for each hour, then average wind speed over the requested period. Resource fallback for the NREL WIND Toolkit.
limitations: Modeled reanalysis, not direct satellite wind measurement. Mean wind and an illustrative capacity-factor curve do not replace a turbine power-curve study.

name: HIFLD Transmission
description: Nearest mapped transmission line distance, computed in a local azimuthal equidistant projection.
limitations: Historic infrastructure inventory. Proximity does not prove connection availability, voltage suitability or spare capacity.

name: PAD-US Protected Areas
description: Union protected-area geometries and calculate footprint overlap. Any positive overlap is excluded when protection is enabled.
limitations: Conservative screening uses Fee, Designation, Easement and Marine polygons regardless of GAP status. Proclamation/planning outlines are omitted. Overlap is not a legal siting determination; local restrictions still need review.

name: Landsat 9 Surface Products
description: Optional optical and surface-temperature cross-check; VIIRS supplies the additional orbital layer in the MVP pipeline.
limitations: Not computed by the current pipeline. Requires QA masking and scale/offset conversion before use.
